text:
I was very unimpressed with the dentist's communication.

I went for a checkup for several cavities and asked which teeth needed immediate attention or treatment so we could plan my treatment together. However, I received no advice; the dentist just kept repeating that I had to choose. I understand I need to choose, but how can I choose without information? The response was dismissive, saying they were all equally in need. Ultimately, I couldn't decide. Only then did I receive a more comprehensive explanation that helped me make a decision.

After that, I switched clinics and learned from another dentist that the condition of each tooth was different, and they had a much clearer treatment prioritization. Some teeth that this clinic recommended fillings, the other clinic said didn't need fillings yet.

Date of service: June 13, 2026

Update June 22, 2026: The clinic acted quite quickly after being informed of the issue. They called to explain, apologize, and said they would improve. I'm not personally upset, I just wanted them to be aware and make improvements so that no other patient has to experience the same disappointment.
